'''Synistahg''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> in the [[Synistahg system]] in the [[Lothal sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Iron Squadron (episode)|Iron Squadron]]" to [[2 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Blockade over Synistahg|blockaded]] Synistahg.<ref name="Iron Squadron" />
